goal: Implement word_frequencies(text) in textkit/stats.py and unittest tests in tests/test_stats.py. Standard library only. Return a plain dict mapping lowercase words to integer counts. Lowercase text using str.lower; tokenize as maximal Unicode alphanumeric runs (letters and digits), with underscores and all punctuation/whitespace as separators. Thus apostrophes split words. Empty/no-word input returns {}. Include a docstring that makes tokenization explicit. Follow existing direct-import unittest conventions. Do not edit other files.
acceptance_criteria: Empty, whitespace-only and punctuation-only inputs yield {}
Tests directly assert explicit expected dictionaries for mixed case, repeated words, tabs/newlines, digits, punctuation, underscores, apostrophes, and Unicode letters
All tests pass via unittest discovery
